# What each mod can touch

Claude Code's own static analyzer (`claude plugin validate`) reads each mod's source and lists every event it hooks and every API it calls. This page is that output, regenerated in CI, so a mod can't quietly gain a capability.

Legend: 🌐 network · ⚙️ runs commands · 🧠 calls a model · 📝 writes files · 🔧 sees or changes tool calls · ✂️ rewrites transcript rows · 🧾 edits the system prompt

| [files-touched](../mods/awareness/files-touched/) | ⚙️ 🔧 | session.start, turn.start, tool.call, command.run{command=touched}, ui.render{component=AbovePrompt}, ui.render{component=Pane, requestId=files-touched} | $.clock.now, $.command.register, $.fs.exists, $.fs.read, $.process.run, $.prompt.fill, $.session.root, $.state.get, $.state.set, $.ui.close, $.ui.copy, $.ui.open, $.ui.resolve, $.ui.toast |
